purpose: Objective retrospective startup-signal qualification and observability sensitivity; no manuscript, outcome model or public-release modification
search_interval: First 600 s after the first finite reference bin, using the frozen full-waveform startup feature cache; no claim of full-record waveform QC

primary_bin_gate.peak_algorithm: Existing frozen SciPy find_peaks, minimum distance 0.3 s, prominence 5 mmHg; pragmatic composite technical screen, NOT validated clinical SQI

primary_onset: Beginning of first 6 consecutive qualifying 10-s bins, retrospectively confirmed by the following 60 s. This is not a real-time onset detector.
no_normal_pressure_requirement: No MAP>=40 or MAP>=65 criterion; low but technically supported pressure can qualify; no selection on AUC, episode counts or statistical significance
reference_after_onset: Mask only pre-onset original MAP bins in primary analysis; do not change original retained MAP values or compress time. Existing original-cohort eligibility retained; report remaining coverage/duration rather than adding a minimum normal-pressure period.
display: All original absolute phases on anaesthesia-origin 10-s grid; discard pre-onset display samples. Primary remains unavailable until first valid scheduled post-onset sample. Secondary seeds first finite post-onset reference only for nonzero phases, exactly matching original native initialization convention.
relaxed_gate: Coverage>=0.8; wave mean 20-180; p05>=-5; p95<=300; span 5-180; 3-40 peaks per10s; waveform/numeric agreement<=15; same optional paired-pressure rule
confirmation_end_sensitivity: Start evaluation 60 s after primary onset; this excludes the qualification segment and changes the analysis window
later_failed_bins_sensitivity: Additionally mask failed core bins after onset within the measured first600s only; do not imply full-record artifact removal
native_events: At least 6 consecutive valid MAP bins below threshold; missing breaks episodes; mutually exclusive fresh low sample, inherited low only, never low. Minimum120s and240s are secondary at5min MAP65, not external-validation claims.
minute_bridge: For age>=25, rebuild minute medians from post-onset MAP requiring>=5/6 valid bins; retain all original qualified-hour masks for matched comparisons. Keep 3-min events and original integer-minute phases. This is a separate technical estimand, not the main60s event endpoint.

inference.phase_aggregation: mean raw components per case first, sum per subject, then patient bootstrap
inference.paired_comparison: same primary-qualified subjects and original/trimmed component vectors

robustness_reporting: Report all rules without choosing by desired net-AUC result; compare sign and magnitude of H/O, episode information, CI and absolute units. No preset clinical equivalence margin or causal-benefit test.
source_validation: Independently stratified raw-waveform/cache verification on32 records when raw tracks accessible; all records checked for numeric-panel/cache alignment. Missing source waveform is not classified as QC pass.
restrictions: No raw or case-level data in delivery
Do not rerun AKI or infusion-adjustment models in this task
Do not update manuscript, GitHub or Zenodo
